stories.title: Un agente del ICE dispara y hiere a un hombre en Nueva York

en.title: An ICE agent shoots and wounds a man in New York
en.summary: An ICE agent fired shots in the Bronx, wounding a man who was in a vehicle with a child present. The wounded man was taken to a local hospital.

stories.title: Un Brasil partido en dos contado desde un edificio ‘art déco’ de Copacabana

en.title: A Brazil divided in two told from an art deco building in Copacabana
en.summary: Residents of a Rio de Janeiro seaside tower who once coexisted with opposing political views and reached compromises are now more polarized, avoiding political discussion altogether.

stories.title: El espacio a la izquierda del PSOE continúa sin ponerse de acuerdo: “Se están repitiendo los errores de 2023”

en.title: The space to the left of the PSOE continues without reaching agreement: "The mistakes of 2023 are being repeated"
en.summary: The Broad Front coalition lacks a candidate for Spain's general elections scheduled for November 29, with observers warning that previous errors are occurring again.

stories.title: Cristina Rivera Garza: “En Texas puedo ser blanco de violencia en cualquier momento”

en.title: Cristina Rivera Garza: "In Texas I can be a target of violence at any moment"
en.summary: Mexican writer Cristina Rivera Garza discusses her latest book and literary influences in an interview, addressing her experiences in Texas.

stories.title: El decreto de vivienda frena la estrategia de los fondos de vender sus casas de alquiler

en.title: Housing decree halts strategy of investment funds to sell their rental properties
en.summary: A housing policy extension is complicating the business plans of major investors who purchased rental property portfolios with the intention of gradually disposing of individual properties.

stories.title: ¿Remonta la izquierda? No en la primera encuesta

en.title: Does the left recover? Not in the first poll
en.summary: A political survey shows limited progress for left-wing parties in their efforts to mobilize voters, retain undecided supporters, and prevent defections to right-wing alternatives.

stories.title: Colau y Montero hablan directamente para desatascar la integración de Podemos en el Frente Amplio

en.title: Colau and Montero speak directly to unblock Podemos integration into Broad Front
en.summary: Negotiations between political figures intensify as primary elections and candidate lists remain unresolved in the context of integrating Podemos into a broader political coalition.

stories.title: Una marcha en honor a Maricarmen recorre Madrid: “¡No son muertes, son asesinatos!”

en.title: A march in honor of Maricarmen crosses Madrid: "These are not deaths, they are murders!"
en.summary: Approximately 20,000 people marched from Puerta del Sol to commemorate an 87-year-old woman who was evicted from her home two weeks prior.

stories.title: Madrid despide a Maricarmen con una marcha multitudinaria y pacífica

en.title: Madrid says goodbye to Maricarmen with a large peaceful march
en.summary: A large peaceful procession took place in Madrid from Sol to Sainz de Baranda street, honoring an elderly woman who lived in that area.

stories.title: Podemos antepone sus primarias y aleja su entrada en Frente Amplio a pesar de la vía Colau

en.title: Podemos prioritizes its primaries and delays its entry into Frente Amplio despite Colau's path
en.summary: Podemos is focusing on its internal primary process scheduled for October 14 and 15, delaying potential integration into Frente Amplio, though Colau's candidacy offers an alternative route for the party's participation.

stories.title: Canadian poet Anne Carson wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature

en.title: Canadian poet Anne Carson wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Anne Carson, a Canadian poet, received the Nobel Prize in Literature for her innovative and creative contributions that established new literary forms and approaches.

stories.title: Anne Carson gana el Nobel de Literatura

en.title: Anne Carson wins Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: The Swedish Academy has recognized Canadian poet Anne Carson for her audacious and inventive work that creates new literary forms through dialogue with classical tradition.

stories.title: Cuál es el nivel de la prima de riesgo de Francia que arrastra a toda Europa

en.title: What is the level of France's risk premium that is dragging all of Europe
en.summary: Analysts are warning about France's rising risk premium potentially spreading contagion to other countries' debt, including Spain, and affecting the euro.

stories.title: CaixaBank acapara el 56% de todo lo que ganan los bancos en seguros

en.title: CaixaBank accounts for 56% of all bank insurance profits
en.summary: CaixaBank dominates bank insurance earnings in 2025, with insurance subsidiaries and policy sales commissions contributing over 20% of total banking sector profits.

stories.title: Telefónica pone en venta su 'fiberco' en Chile por hasta 1.800 millones

en.title: Telefónica puts its 'fiberco' in Chile up for sale for up to 1.8 billion
en.summary: Telefónica and KKR, which hold 40% and 60% stakes respectively in a Chilean fiber optic company, have engaged JPMorgan and Scotiabank to sell the firm that provides services to most operators in the country.

stories.title: Miles de personas marchan en Madrid hasta la casa de Maricarmen para rendirle homenaje

en.title: Thousands march in Madrid to Maricarmen's home to pay tribute to her
en.summary: Thousands of people gathered peacefully at the former residence of Maricarmen Abascal to honor her following her death at a Madrid hospital where she had been admitted after an eviction.

stories.title: Este fin de semana gratis con Expansión, Fuera de Serie

en.title: Free this weekend with Expansión, Fuera de Serie
en.summary: Expansión's special edition includes over 160 pages featuring articles on design, fashion, gastronomy, and travel.
